selectedExecutionBoundary.continuousTypedQuantization: Changing continuous inputs to quantizing casts, non-float64 typed arithmetic, bit operations and fixed LUT require an explicit held boundary. Constant or already-held inputs are supported. Smooth float64 complex-to-legacy paths can feed the existing solver.
selectedExecutionBoundary.fixedStateSpace: Same binary-point fixed metadata for A/B/C/D/initial/input; n,m,p1..8. Each product and accumulated add applies selected rounding/overflow. No reset or mixed-scale realization. Output reads current state, transition commits atomically. finalState is held output and stateMemory contains internal x.
selectedExecutionBoundary.binaryPointShift: Positive shift is right binary-point shift: new fractionLength=old fractionLength-shift; stored code unchanged and real value multiplied by2^shift.
selectedExecutionBoundary.schema: Existing schemaVersion1 retained; tagged signals extend its value contract with explicit defensive validation and no lossy migration.
